h1: Two-star Table by Bruno Verjus in Paris to close in December
title: Two-Star Table by Bruno Verjus in Paris to Close in December
description: Bruno Verjus will close Table, his two-Michelin-star restaurant in Paris, on 22 December 2026, saying fine dining at its prices is for too few.
summary: The 12th-arrondissement two-star, No. 3 on The World’s 50 Best in 2024, serves its €480 menu until 22 December.
body:
Table, Bruno Verjus’s two-MICHELIN-star restaurant in Paris’s 12th arrondissement, will close on 22 December 2026, he announced in a video on 8 September. Until then it serves one menu, “Couleur du jour”, at {{dinner:table-bruno-verjus}} without drinks, at lunch and dinner.

Why Table is closing

Verjus said he no longer recognises himself in fine dining whose prices keep it for a few, and wants to cook for a wider public; he has not announced what comes next. Table opened more than 13 years ago and was No. 3 on The World’s 50 Best Restaurants in 2024.

How to eat there before it closes

The menu is the same at lunch and dinner, so there is no cheaper way in. For other starred meals in the city, our Paris Michelin star restaurants page lists every one with its dinner, lunch and wine pairing prices, including Table until it closes.
